text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `infra-queue-backlog` (P1) — triggered by threshold: queue_length > 12000 for 2m. Runbook: infra/queue/backlog.md. Pager: Sam L (primary)

Sam L: on it, grabbing context. +1 min to get laptop set up.

SRE Oncall: Sam if you don't ack in 2m it will escalate to Morgan R (secondary). FYI customer-facing queues are affected.

Sam L: acked (sorry lag, phone battery dead). seeing spike in `ingest-queue` from kafka consumer lag.

infra-bot: Observed metrics snapshot: `ingest-queue.size=13,421`, `consumer-lag=350k`, `host-gpu-usage=72%`, `host-iowait=18%`. Top producers: svc-ingest-v2 (10k rps).

Morgan R: noted. Sam, can you confirm whether this is sustained or a burst? also any deploys in the last 30m?

Sam L: no deploys flagged in deploybot. Looks sustained for ~3m. Investigating consumer consumers: one pod crashed and restarted repeatedly. logs: ```
2026-03-15T01:02:12Z ERROR kafka consumer crashed OOM
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
```

Ryan C: that OOM matches a recent JVM bump config change in svc-ingest-v2. Rolling back that change might help.

Sam L: trying `kubectl scale deployment svc-ingest-v2 --replicas=0` to stop producing, then we'll bring them back with old JVM flag. Executing now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 120s -> alert escalated to Morgan R (secondary). (automated)

Morgan R: I got the escalation. Sam said acked but PD shows delayed; thanks for the heads up. If we stop producers temporarily we should see queue drain. Sam, confirm scale succeeded?

Sam L: scale succeeded, producers at 0, consumer lag still high but no new enqueue since scale. starting controlled consumer scale-up to drain.

Alex G: I'm the manager on-call. Woke up from escalation pinged by PagerDuty. Do we have customer impact? any external 5xxs?

Ryan C: no 5xxs reported yet, but API tail latency spiking for a subset of requests that touch that queue. Estimated affected customers: ~12 tenants. Not a full outage but degraded.

Sam L: creating temp rule to divert high-priority traffic away from the affected workers: `nginx:set-weight svc-ingest-v2=0` for canary ring. Applying.

infra-bot: Traffic rule update applied. weight for svc-ingest-v2 -> 0. Monitoring.

Morgan R: good. Can we also hotfix JVM flags and spin new pods? I can push the old flag as a patch.

Sam L: patch pushed, `kubectl rollout restart deployment/svc-ingest-v2` with env JVM_FLAGS=-Xmx6g (previous was -Xmx12g causing OOM in low memory container). Rolling pods.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary did not ack within 180s -> alert escalated to Alex G (manager). (automated)

Alex G: I acknowledged now. I'll coordinate customer comms after we confirm stabilization. Who's owning RCA?

SRE Oncall: Sam/Morgan own immediate mitigation. Postmortem owner: Alex G agreed. Please document timeline and include runbook gaps.

Sam L: new pods are healthy. queue size dropping: 13,421 -> 3,200 in 6m. consumer-lag -> 42k. CPU on consumers stable.

Ryan C: good signal. revert traffic rule after backlog under 500.

Sam L: revert applied. traffic back to normal.

Alex G: thanks all. I'll draft a brief customer note: "We experienced degraded processing for a subset of tenants due to an ingest service OOM; mitigation applied and normal processing resumed. Full RCA and timeline to follow." Any objections?

Morgan R: lgtm. add that we paused producers, rolled JVM flag, and restarted pods.

Sam L: filing incident ticket INC-2026-0315 and attaching logs + `kubectl` commands run. Will include exact PD alert IDs.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by Sam L. Closing PagerDuty alert. :white_check_mark:

Alex G: schedule follow-up postmortem with SRE and infra teams tomorrow 11:00 PT. Sam/Morgan please add remediation actions (alert tuning to detect memory config drift, a canary for JVM flag changes).

Sam L: ack. also recommend PagerDuty policy tweak: increase primary ack window to 180s for this alert type to avoid noisy manager escalations when oncall is briefly unreachable.

Morgan R: agree. also add runbook step to automatically snapshot JVM flags on deploy and fail deploy if delta > 10% of heap size.

Ryan C: I'll open the PR for deploy guard.

SRE Oncall: thanks everyone. tagging follow-up owners: Alex G (postmortem), Sam L (mitigation writeup), Ryan C (deploy guard PR), Morgan R (runbook updates).

Alex G: closing thread. admins please mark incident as P1 -> resolved, and record the PD escalation chain for review. :thumbsup:
